answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments generate succinct proofs, while verifiable delay primitives enforce sequentiality to ensure that no adversary can forge valid credentials. Upon this cryptographic knoll, VRF-based leader sortition prevents Sybil-driven Byzantine faults. By anchoring state to a jetty of ordered blocks, we achieve information-theoretic unforgeability and finality, rendering identity spoofing computationally infeasible.
